facts.dumbo: The dumbo octopus flaps the two fins on its head to swim, like big floppy ears. It lives deeper down than almost any other octopus.
facts.starfish: A starfish has a tiny eye at the tip of every arm. And if it loses an arm, it can grow a new one!
facts.phantom-jelly: The giant phantom jelly lives so deep that people have only seen it a few times. Its four floppy arms can grow as long as a bus.
facts.firefly: The firefly squid is only as long as your finger, but it makes its own blue light. In Japan, whole bays sparkle blue when they come close to the shore.
facts.lantern-jelly: Many deep-sea jellies make their own light. When something bumps them, they flash bright blue, like a little alarm calling for help.
facts.nautilus: A nautilus lives in a shell with lots of little rooms inside. It fills them with gas or water to float up and sink down, like a submarine.
